brief:
Jerusalem's electricity company announced it will cut electrical power to several areas of Bethlehem governorate on Monday, August 24, 2026, the Ma'an Wire reported. The blackout will run from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. and will affect parts of Beit Sahour and other zones within the governorate.

The company said the service interruption was necessary but did not specify the reason for the outage or the maintenance work behind it. Residents in the affected areas should prepare accordingly for the four-hour power cut during daytime hours.
